Hello! We are a trading company whose customer group is pharmaceutical, biotechnology and beverage production companies. We offered our customers filters and various filtration systems intended for production. We would need to create an online store home page. We would like to expect from the website: - Description/price/picture for each item we offer (easy to use, so we can add and remove items later); - Possibility to place an order online (an invoice is automatically generated for the customer and sent to the e-mail address specified by him); - Possibility to place your goods in the shopping cart, make payment; - Choose the delivery method; - ENG/LV languages; - Preferably without a monthly/annual subscription fee for the platform on which this page is located. text:
You need an online store for filtration products that lets you easily manage items, support ENG/LV, take orders and payments, choose delivery methods, and automatically generate and email invoices.

I can build this as a practical full-stack storefront with the product catalog, cart, checkout, and order flow you described. With 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and full-stack development, I’d focus on making the site easy for your team to update later without needing technical help.

Relevant experience:
- Booking platform for fitness studios — I built a white-label class booking app with subdomains, timetables, memberships, and Stripe payments. One result: 64 studios onboarded in 6 months, with a 71% checkout conversion.
- Home goods storefront rebuild — I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. One result: largest contentful paint improved from 4.1s to 1.3s.

For your project, I would suggest:
- Product pages with description, price, and image management
- Shopping cart and secure checkout
- Payment integration
- Delivery method selection
- Automatic invoice generation and email sending after order placement
- English and Latvian language support
- A structure that avoids monthly or annual platform subscription fees where possible

A good approach would be a custom-built storefront, so you own the site and can add or remove products later from an admin-friendly interface. That also gives us flexibility for invoicing, delivery options, and multilingual content.

In terms of timing, this is very feasible as a focused build. The exact schedule depends on how many product categories, delivery rules, and invoice details you need, but I can give you a clearer estimate once I understand the full scope.

For cost, it would depend on the final feature set and content workflow, especially around invoice automation, language handling, and how the catalog is managed. If you’d like, I can outline a practical implementation plan and a more accurate estimate based on your preferred structure.
